address: 65B Rua Direita Carlos Eugénio, Taipa, Macau
bio: This cosy hangout has long been attracting a loyal following for its tasty, homespun food at affordable prices. Now run by the late owner’s son, it continues to welcome diners like family, offering carefully crafted, authentic Portuguese fare. Their signature stewed pork with clams delivers balanced flavours and a pleasant kick due to coriander and a secret sauce. The made to order salted cod fritters are served piping hot....
